## Description

Buys a put and sells a lower-strike put to express downside momentum with a defined premium outlay and capped payoff.

## Where it may fit

Bearish trend or downside breakout when implied volatility and spread pricing remain reasonable.

## Vehicles

Equity/index options, tactical hedging and directional options portfolios.

## Required data

Option chain, strike/expiry, implied vol surface, underlying price, trend signals, bid/ask and corporate-event calendar.

## Caveats

Limited risk is not low risk; time decay, volatility changes and spread liquidity can cause the position to lose most of its debit.
